title: 酥皮鸭，花乃井，罗西马，狂野男爵，记忆

segments.t: 中文译名“酥皮鸭”（我认为就是音译，这货跟鸭子没有白毛钱关系），拉丁名：Echeveria Supia。关于他的名字在亚洲有很多不同叫法，较终统一为supia。声明：所有的图片资料来源于ICN，并非本人种植，仅作研究多肉科属用途，ICN给出了此种多肉的开花及日常图片，非常有参考意义。博主认为了解多肉以拉丁名较为准确。

Supia

Description by Margrit Bischofberger and Park Kwan-Jae

Short description :

A much branched subshrub, at first growing fast, later only slowly.

Rosettes terminal, up to 5 cm in diameter, rather loose; leaves up to 2,5 cm long and 1 cm wide, margins purple when grown in full sun; flowers red outside and bright yellow inside, pedicels missing or very short.

E. ‘Supia’ resembles E. pringlei var. parva, but it is not this species. The leaves of E. pringlei var. parva are much smaller and the flower colour is orange – and most important – the pedicels are 4-6 mm long.

中文译名“花乃井”，拉丁名：Echeveria AMOENA De Smet, 1875。起源于墨西哥的一种多肉植物。声明：所有的图片资料来源于ICN，并非本人种植，仅作研究多肉科属用途，ICN给出了此种多肉的开花及日常图片，非常有参考意义。博主认为了解多肉以拉丁名较为准确。

AMOENA De Smet, 1875

Series Paniculatae

Distribution Mexico (Puebla, Veracruz)

Description (according to IHSP 2003) :

Stem to 5 cm or more, 3 – 5 mm in diameter, branching.

Rosette 2,5 – 5,5 cm in diameter.

Leaves obovate-spatulate, cuspidate, 1 – 2 x 0,7 – 1,5 cm, ± 4 mm thick near tip, glaucous-green, often red-tipped.

Inflorescences laxly cymose-paniculate with cincinni, ± 10 – 20 cm long, bracts minute, 4 – 10 (-20) mm, easily detached, pedicel slender, 1 – 3 cm.

Flowers : Sepals slightly spreading, < 3 mm, corolla cylindrical, 7 – 9 x ± 4 mm in diameter near the base, salmon-orange.

Cytology : n = 33,66.

中文译名“罗西马”（直接音译），拉丁名：Echeveria LONGISSIMA var. LONGISSIMA Walther, 1938。起源于墨西哥的一种多肉植物。声明：所有的图片资料来源于ICN，并非本人种植，仅作研究多肉科属用途，ICN给出了此种多肉的开花及日常图片，非常有参考意义。博主认为了解多肉以拉丁名较为准确。

LONGISSIMA var. LONGISSIMA Walther, 1938

Synonym : Echeveria harmsii var. multiflora Walther (1935)

Series Longistylae

Distribution: Mexico (Oaxaca: Paraje San Bartolo, N of Conceptión de Buenavista; Puebla).

Description (according to IHSP, 2003) :

Stem < 5 cm long, ± 1,5 cm in diameter, almost always unbranched.

Rosette flat, 6 – 7 cm in diameter.

Leaves broadly obovate-cuneate, cuspidate, 6 x 3 cm, dark green, glabrous, often red-margined.

Inflorescences to 30 cm tall with 1 – 3 cincinni, bracts conspicuous, nearly overlapping, pedicels 10 – 17 mm, without bracteoles.

Flowers : 4 - 12, sepals ascending to widely spreading, ovate-deltoid to oblong-lanceolate, to 8 mm, corolla narrowly urceolate-cylindrical, to > 30 mm long, 10 mm in diameter near base, petals narrowly oblong, weakly keeled, green near tips, otherwise orange, stamens to 25 mm.

Cytology : n = 42
